hiro_mikotoya.price_note: Anago prices read off the shop's own handwritten card and shopfront board photographed 2026-05. The oyster dishes come from the shop's 2025-09 card and were not on the 2026 card. A notice pinned beside the board explains that conger-eel wholesale prices at the Hiroshima fish market have surged and that the shop has had to raise its anago prices. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Grilled conger eel over rice, lacquer box - large/premium portion
items.note: Anago is basted with a soy-sauce-and-mirin tare, which is wheat by default; the set includes chawanmushi made with dashi and usually soy sauce.

items.en: Grilled conger eel over rice in a lacquer box
items.note: Wheat-containing soy tare on the eel. Card notes it comes with a kobachi side and chawanmushi.

items.ja: 広島牛ローストビーフと穴子の重
items.romaji: Hiroshima-gyu roast beef to anago no ju
items.en: Hiroshima beef roast beef and conger eel over rice
items.note: Roast beef sauce and eel tare are both soy-based (wheat). Comes with chawanmushi.

items.en: Conger eel rice bowl
items.note: Soy tare (wheat). Card lists a kobachi side and chawanmushi with it.

items.en: Conger eel rice cooked and served in an iron pot
items.note: Rice is cooked in a seasoned dashi that contains soy sauce (wheat). Comes with a kobachi and chawanmushi; takes time to cook, so order early.

items.en: Fried oyster set meal
items.section: Oysters (2025-09 card; not seen on the 2026 card)
items.note: Panko-breaded and deep-fried - wheat crumb and a shared fryer. Price is from the 2025-09 card and is likely to have risen.

items.en: Fried oysters, a la carte
items.section: Oysters (2025-09 card; not seen on the 2026 card)
items.note: Panko-breaded, deep-fried. 2025-09 price.

items.ja: 蓬莱鶴 純米吟醸 萌えいぶき
items.en: Horaizuru junmai ginjo sake, Hiroshima
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Rice sake from the shop's Hiroshima local-sake card. Not assessed for gluten - junmai sake is rice and koji, but the shop makes no allergen statement.

items.ja: 賀茂金秀 特別純米13
items.en: Kamokinshu tokubetsu junmai sake, Saijo, Hiroshima
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Hiroshima local sake listed on the shop's card.

items.en: Kamotsuru dry ginjo sake, Saijo, Hiroshima
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Dry ginjo from Hiroshima's best-known brewery.

items.en: Hanahato kimoto junmai sake, Kure, Hiroshima
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Cheapest junmai on the card.

items.en: Kirei 'Kasen' sake, Saijo, Hiroshima
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: House pour; kasen grade is an everyday blended sake.

items.ja: 雨後の月 広島梅酒 あらごし
items.romaji: Ugo no Tsuki Hiroshima umeshu aragoshi
items.en: Ugo no Tsuki coarse-strained Hiroshima plum liqueur
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Plum liqueur with the fruit pulp left in. Base spirit not stated on the card - ask if it matters.

items.en: Hiroshima lemon liqueur, dry style
items.section: 広島の地酒 Hiroshima local sake (2025-09 card)
items.note: Card's own wording: 100% Hiroshima lemons, a not-sweet, crisp style.

hiro_okonomiyaki_ganchan.price_note: Transcribed from the shop's own wall board photographed 2023-08 - the newest picture of it online. The same board photographed in 2018 shows lower add-on prices (nama-ika 200, ika-ten 100, mochi 100), so it is repriced from time to time and the 2023 figures may again be out of date. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Hiroshima okonomiyaki with pork, egg and yakisoba noodles - the house standard
items.note: Wheat crepe batter, wheat yakisoba noodles and a wheat-and-soy okonomi sauce, cooked on a shared griddle. The default order at any Hiroshima okonomiyaki counter.

items.en: The same okonomiyaki built with udon instead of soba noodles
items.note: Udon is wheat, as are the batter and the sauce. The board prices this the same as the soba version.

items.en: 'Special' okonomiyaki - the loaded build
items.note: The board gives no composition; at Hiroshima counters 'special' means the deluxe build with squid and prawn added to the pork, egg and noodles. Wheat batter, noodles and sauce.

items.en: Extra cheese
items.note: Processed cheese; dairy. The griddle is shared with wheat batter, so not celiac-safe in practice.

items.en: Extra fresh squid
items.note: Plain squid griddled into the pancake - wheat-free in itself, but the griddle and the finishing sauce are not.

items.en: Extra rice cake
items.note: Plain glutinous rice cake - rice only despite the English name. Cooked on the shared wheat griddle.

items.en: Extra squid tempura crisp
items.note: A wheat-battered fried squid cracker crumbled into the pancake - a Hiroshima okonomiyaki signature, and definitely wheat.

items.en: Extra spring onion
items.note: Just sliced green onion; the wheat comes from the pancake and sauce it goes on.

items.en: Pork wrapped in a thin omelette on the griddle
items.note: Egg-wrapped pork finished with okonomi sauce and mayonnaise; the sauce is wheat-and-soy based.

items.en: Thin griddled snack pancake, no noodles, to go with a drink
items.note: A thin wheat-batter pancake without the noodle layer - the cheapest thing on the board and a good order if you only want a taste.

hiro_shoryuken.price_note: Noodle and drink prices are the 2026-05 white price stickers pasted over the shop's printed wall boards. The a-la-carte (ippin) prices and the toppings are from the 2025-07 photograph of the same boards, where they were still the printed figures - those may have been re-stickered since. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Hakata-style tonkotsu ramen - the house bowl
items.note: Thin wheat noodles in pork-bone broth; the tare is soy-based. Shop is a sister of Nagahama Number One, the Hakata tonkotsu chain, and opens 20:00-05:00 as a late-night bowl.

items.en: Tonkotsu ramen loaded with extra roast pork
items.note: Chashu is braised in soy sauce (wheat) on top of the wheat noodles.

items.en: Tonkotsu ramen under a heap of spring onion
items.note: Wheat noodles; the negi is often dressed in a sesame-and-soy oil.

items.en: Tonkotsu ramen topped with bean sprouts
items.note: Wheat noodles and a pork broth - the sprouts do not make it vegetarian.

items.en: Tonkotsu ramen with a soy-marinated soft egg
items.note: The egg is marinated in wheat soy sauce; noodles are wheat.

items.en: Spicy tonkotsu ramen - choose heat level 1 to 10
items.note: The order board asks you to pick a heat number from 1-kara to 10-kara and recommends 2-kara. Wheat noodles, soy tare.

items.en: 'Painful' ramen - the extreme-heat challenge bowl
items.note: The shop's own name for it is 'painful'. Dearest bowl on the board. Wheat noodles, soy tare.

items.en: Hiroshima-style cold dipping noodles in a chilli-sesame sauce
items.note: Hiroshima tsukemen is served cold with raw cabbage and a red chilli dipping sauce, not the thick fish-pork dip of Tokyo tsukemen. Heat is chosen 1-kara / chu-kara / dai-kara. Noodles and the soy-based dip are both wheat.

items.en: Hiroshima soupless spicy noodles - mix the chilli oil, egg and noodles together
items.note: Heat chosen ko-kara / chu-kara / dai-kara, with the board recommending ko-kara. Wheat noodles; the seasoning oil is soy-based.

items.en: Tonkotsu ramen with spicy pickled mustard greens
items.note: Takana pickles are usually seasoned with soy sauce; noodles and broth are as above.

items.ja: ラーメン定食（ラーメン・ギョーザ4個・ライス）
items.en: Set meal: ramen, four gyoza and a bowl of rice
items.note: Gyoza wrappers are wheat and the dipping sauce is soy - this set is wheat three times over. Best-value order on the board.

items.en: Griddled chicken thigh over rice
items.note: Chicken is griddled with a soy-based seasoning (wheat); the only non-noodle main on the board.

items.en: Bowl of Koshihikari rice
items.note: Plain steamed white rice, nothing added - the board names the varietal, Koshihikari. Rice on its own is the one naturally gluten-free thing in this shop; anything you put on it will not be.

items.en: Large bowl of rice
items.note: Same plain steamed rice, larger portion; nothing is added to it.

items.en: Extra noodle refill for your bowl
items.note: The Hakata custom: order a second helping of noodles into your remaining broth. Wheat.

items.en: Pan-fried pork dumplings, six pieces
items.section: 一品メニュー A la carte (2025-07 prices)
items.note: Wheat wrappers, wheat-soy dipping sauce, shared pan.

items.en: Roast pork slices heaped with spring onion
items.section: 一品メニュー A la carte (2025-07 prices)
items.note: Chashu is soy-braised (wheat); usually dressed with sesame oil and more soy.

items.en: Roast pork with bean sprouts
items.section: 一品メニュー A la carte (2025-07 prices)
items.note: Same soy-braised pork over dressed sprouts.

items.en: Griddled chicken thigh, a la carte
items.section: 一品メニュー A la carte (2025-07 prices)
items.note: The rice-bowl version without the rice; soy-based seasoning.

items.en: Raw beef omasum (third stomach), sliced
items.section: 一品メニュー A la carte (2025-07 prices)
items.note: Served raw and crunchy; the dip is usually either sesame oil and salt (no wheat) or a vinegar-miso, which can contain barley. Ask which one this shop uses.

items.en: Soupless tonkotsu-oil noodles - handwritten 'new menu' item
items.note: On a paper sign taped to the counter; the price was written as 800 and then crossed out and raised to 850. Wheat noodles in seasoned pork fat and soy tare.

items.en: Add a soy-marinated soft egg
items.note: Marinated in wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Add spring onion
items.note: Plain sliced onion, but often pre-dressed in a soy-sesame oil - ask if it is seasoned.

items.en: Add spicy pickled mustard greens
items.note: Plant-based, but takana pickles are almost always seasoned with wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Add bean sprouts
items.note: Plain sprouts; whether they are dressed is worth asking.

items.ja: チャーシュー（トッピング）
items.en: Add extra roast pork
items.note: Soy-braised pork - wheat. Price digits partly obscured in the photograph; read as 250.

items.ja: 生ビール（アサヒスーパードライ）
items.en: Draught Asahi Super Dry
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks (2026-05 stickers)
items.note: Beer is brewed from barley malt - never gluten-free.

items.en: Whisky highball
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks (2026-05 stickers)
items.note: Made with malt/grain whisky - treat as not gluten-free.

items.en: Lemon shochu highball
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Base shochu is unstated; barley shochu (mugi-jochu) is common and is barley. Ask which base they pour.

items.en: Sake (house pour)
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Brand not stated on the board.

items.en: Shochu (house pour)
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Grain unstated - barley shochu contains barley, sweet-potato and rice shochu do not. Ask.

items.en: Plum liqueur
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Base spirit unstated; some umeshu is built on barley shochu.

items.ja: ソフトドリンク 各種
items.en: Soft drinks, various
items.section: ドリンクメニュー Drinks
items.note: Board does not list which ones.

items.ja: 麺の濃さ／スープの濃さ（お好みで）
items.romaji: men no kosa / supu no kosa
items.en: Noodle firmness and broth richness are yours to choose
items.note: Not a dish - the ordering board. Noodle firmness runs konaotoshi (barely cooked), harigane, barikata (the shop's pick), kata, futsu, yawa. Broth runs kotteri, futsu (the shop's pick), assari, super-assari. Say one from each list when you order.

hiro_shikisai.price_note: Course prices and the hotpot list are from the shop's own site. The a-la-carte dishes are transcribed from the shop's own printed menu sheets photographed 2024-12 (meat and vegetable page) and 2023-06 (the seafood kondate page). The shop states in writing that both the a-la-carte menu and the courses change with the season, so treat the fish page in particular as a sample of what a given month looks like rather than a fixed list. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Set course, entry level - amuse, sashimi and seasonal dishes
items.section: コース Courses (shop's own site, tax included)
items.note: Shop's site: courses run 3,500 / 4,500 / 5,500 yen tax-included, the number of dishes rising with the price, and must be booked by the previous day. All-you-can-drink can be priced on request. Assume soy sauce and dashi throughout unless you brief them.

items.en: Set course, middle grade
items.section: コース Courses (shop's own site, tax included)
items.note: Same structure with more dishes. Reserve by the day before.

items.en: Set course, top grade
items.section: コース Courses (shop's own site, tax included)
items.note: Same structure, most dishes. Reserve by the day before.

items.ja: カニ鍋（松葉ガニ・ズワイガニ）
items.en: Snow crab hotpot
items.section: 鍋料理 Hotpots (shop's own site; price on request)
items.note: Hotpots must be booked two days ahead. Broth base is not published; nabe stock in a Japanese izakaya is normally dashi plus soy sauce or miso, both of which usually carry wheat or barley.

items.en: Mixed seafood hotpot
items.section: 鍋料理 Hotpots (shop's own site; price on request)
items.note: Two days' notice. Soy-seasoned broth by default.

items.en: Tiger pufferfish hotpot
items.section: 鍋料理 Hotpots (shop's own site; price on request)
items.note: Two days' notice. Fugu-chiri is normally a plain kombu broth with a ponzu dip - and ponzu is soy sauce, i.e. wheat, unless they can make it otherwise.

items.en: Hiroshima oyster hotpot in miso broth
items.section: 鍋料理 Hotpots (shop's own site; price on request)
items.note: The signature winter pot in Hiroshima. Miso broth - and miso in western Japan is frequently mugi-miso, made with barley. Two days' notice.

items.ja: あんこう鍋（味噌仕立て）
items.en: Monkfish hotpot in miso broth
items.section: 鍋料理 Hotpots (shop's own site; price on request)
items.note: Miso base - barley risk as above. Two days' notice.

items.ja: 広島産 黒毛和牛リブロース陶板焼（見浦牛）
items.en: Hiroshima black wagyu rib-eye grilled on a ceramic plate at your table
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Miura-gyu is a named Hiroshima wagyu herd. The dearest single plate on the sheet. Beef and the ceramic plate are clean; the dipping sauce that comes with toban-yaki is normally ponzu or a soy tare - ask for salt and wasabi instead.

items.ja: 黒毛和牛筋肉とじゃが芋みそ煮（見浦牛）
items.romaji: kuroge wagyu sujiniku to jagaimo miso-ni
items.en: Wagyu beef tendon and potato simmered in miso
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Miso simmer - barley miso is standard in this region - and long-simmered dishes almost always take soy sauce too.

items.ja: 黒毛和牛やおぎも煮（広島郷土料理）
items.en: Simmered wagyu offal, a Hiroshima home dish
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: The sheet labels it a Hiroshima local dish. Simmered in soy and miso.

items.ja: 広島産 穀美豚の野菜金山寺味噌焼き
items.en: Hiroshima Kokubiton pork grilled with vegetable kinzanji miso
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Kinzanji miso is a chunky miso fermented with barley and wheat as well as soy beans - one of the most reliably wheat-bearing things on any Japanese menu.

items.ja: 広島産 放し飼い地鶏もも肉直火焼き
items.en: Free-range Hiroshima chicken thigh grilled over open flame
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Plain flame-grilled chicken is the closest thing to a gluten-free main here - but ask whether it is salted or basted in tare, since tare is soy sauce.

items.ja: 広島産 赤鶏手羽と焼豆腐赤みそ煮
items.en: Chicken wings and grilled tofu simmered in red miso
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Red miso simmer; miso and soy sauce both in play.

items.ja: 広島産 だし巻き玉子（平飼い育精卵使用）
items.en: Rolled dashi omelette made with barn-raised Hiroshima eggs
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: The dashi in a dashimaki is seasoned with soy sauce or shiro-dashi, both wheat; the bonito dashi and the eggs also rule it out for vegans.

items.ja: 広島産 ふろ吹き大根肉みそ掛け
items.en: Slow-simmered daikon under a meat-miso sauce
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: The daikon itself is simmered in dashi; the topping is pork and miso.

items.ja: かぼちゃ饅頭ひき肉餡かけ
items.en: Steamed pumpkin dumpling under a minced-meat sauce
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: The manju is usually bound with potato or kuzu starch rather than flour, but the thickened ankake sauce is dashi and soy. Ask about the binder if it matters.

items.ja: 野菜天ぷら（れんこん・かぼちゃ）
items.en: Vegetable tempura - lotus root and pumpkin
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Wheat-flour batter and a shared fryer; the tentsuyu dip is soy and bonito dashi. Vegetables only, so ask whether the batter carries egg and whether they will give you salt instead of the dip.

items.en: Deep-fried taro
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Karaage coating is wheat flour and/or potato starch and it comes out of the same fryer as everything else.

items.en: Fried taro under a crab-thickened sauce
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Fried coating plus a dashi-and-soy ankake.

items.ja: 小かぶ含み煮ゆず味噌かけ
items.en: Baby turnips simmered until translucent, with yuzu miso
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Simmered in bonito dashi (not vegan) and topped with miso, which in this region is often barley.

items.en: Lotus-root cake, fried and served in broth
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Agedashi means fried then sat in a dashi-and-soy broth.

items.ja: 京都産 湯葉包み揚げ（黒鯛昆布〆とチーズ入り）
items.romaji: yuba tsutsumi-age (kurodai kobujime to chizu iri)
items.en: Kyoto tofu skin wrapped around kombu-cured black sea bream and cheese, deep-fried
items.section: 肉・野菜 Meat and vegetables (2024-12 sheet)
items.note: Yuba itself is soy, but this is deep-fried and contains fish and cheese.

items.ja: アボカドと音戸ちりめんのサラダ
items.romaji: abokado to Ondo chirimen no sarada
items.en: Avocado salad with tiny dried sardines from Ondo
items.note: Ondo is the strait south of Kure, known for its chirimen whitebait. Dressing composition not published - most Japanese salad dressings contain soy sauce.

items.ja: カツオオイル漬けとチーズのサラダ
items.romaji: katsuo oiru-zuke to chizu no sarada
items.en: Oil-cured bonito and cheese salad
items.note: Fish and dairy. Dressing unstated.

items.ja: たっぷりとまとドレッシングサラダ
items.en: Salad heaped with tomato in a tomato dressing
items.note: The one salad that could plausibly be vegan - but Japanese tomato dressings routinely include soy sauce and sometimes bonito. Ask.

items.ja: ひきわり納豆と茶そばのサラダ
items.romaji: hikiwari natto to chasoba no sarada
items.en: Salad of chopped natto and cold green-tea soba noodles
items.note: Chasoba is buckwheat cut with wheat flour and the dressing will be mentsuyu, i.e. soy and bonito. Natto's own sachet sauce is soy too.

items.ja: 山口産 カマス 昆布〆炙り造り
items.en: Yamaguchi barracuda, kombu-cured and seared, sliced as sashimi
items.note: The curing is kombu and salt only, so the fish itself is clean - it is the soy sauce at the table that is wheat. Ask for salt or a gluten-free tamari. Sheet is marked tax-included.

items.ja: 広島産 ハマチ 刺身
items.en: Hiroshima young yellowtail sashimi
items.note: Raw fish is naturally gluten-free; the dipping soy sauce is not.

items.ja: 広島産 サヨリ 刺身
items.en: Hiroshima halfbeak sashimi
items.note: A delicate spring fish. Same soy-sauce caveat.

items.ja: 広島産 コチ 刺身
items.en: Hiroshima flathead sashimi
items.note: Firm white summer fish, the dearest sashimi on the sheet. Same soy-sauce caveat.

items.ja: コチ カマと腹身煮付け
items.en: Flathead collar and belly simmered in soy
items.note: Nitsuke is by definition a soy-sauce, sake and sugar simmer - wheat.

items.ja: 広島産 太刀魚 炙り造り
items.en: Hiroshima scabbardfish, skin seared, as sashimi
items.note: Seared with nothing but flame. Soy sauce at the table is the wheat.

items.ja: 太刀魚 ねぎ巻き天ぷら
items.en: Scabbardfish rolled round spring onion and deep-fried
items.note: Wheat batter, shared fryer.

items.ja: 太刀魚 エンガワかぜ干し炙り
items.en: Wind-dried scabbardfish fin muscle, grilled
items.note: Cheapest thing on the fish sheet and a proper drinker's snack - the narrow strip of muscle along the fin, air-dried and grilled. Ask whether the drying brine contained soy sauce.

items.ja: 広島産 アジ 酢〆造り
items.en: Hiroshima horse mackerel cured in vinegar, sliced
items.note: Salt-and-vinegar cure, no soy in the curing itself. Ask about the dip.

items.ja: 広島産 アジ 刺身・天ぷら
items.en: Horse mackerel, either as sashimi or as tempura
items.note: Sheet prices both preparations the same. The sashimi is fine but for the table soy sauce; the tempura is wheat batter.

items.ja: 広島産 タコ と里芋の煮物
items.en: Octopus simmered with taro
items.note: Simmered in dashi and soy sauce.

items.en: Octopus dressed in sweet vinegar-miso
items.note: Nuta is miso thinned with vinegar and sugar; miso here is likely barley.

items.ja: 広島産 馬ヅラハギ 肝と豆腐の煮付け
items.romaji: umazurahagi kimo to tofu no nitsuke
items.en: Filefish liver and tofu simmered in soy
items.note: Filefish liver is the local delicacy - rich like monkfish liver. Soy simmer.

items.ja: 広島産 スズキ 頭とカマとの煮付け
items.romaji: suzuki atama to kama no nitsuke
items.en: Sea bass head and collar simmered in soy
items.note: Soy-sauce simmer. The collar is the best-eating part of the fish.

items.ja: 広島産 下ビラメ 天ぷら
items.en: Hiroshima sole tempura
items.note: Wheat batter, shared fryer.

items.ja: 広島産 アナゴ 天ぷら
items.en: Hiroshima conger eel tempura
items.note: Wheat batter. Anago is the Hiroshima Bay speciality.

items.ja: アナゴ 煮アナゴ炙り焼き
items.en: Conger eel simmered then seared
items.note: Simmered in a soy tare before searing.

items.ja: 広島産 カキ 松前焼き・松前蒸し
items.en: Hiroshima oysters grilled or steamed matsumae-style, with kombu
items.note: Matsumae means cooked on or with kombu. The kombu and oyster are clean; matsumae preparations are usually finished with soy sauce and sake, so ask.

items.ja: カキとキノコの揚げだし
items.en: Fried oysters and mushrooms in broth
items.note: Dusted, fried, then sat in a dashi-and-soy broth.

hiro_yamashiroya.price_note: Read off the shop's own laminated table cards photographed 2026-08 - about as current as a menu photograph gets. For comparison the same card in 2025-01 listed anago-meshi at 2,200 yen with a 2,500 yen large size and grilled oysters at 600 yen, so the shop has since settled on one anago size at 2,500 and put the oysters up to 700. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Grilled conger eel over rice - the Miyajima dish, and essentially the whole menu here
items.note: The card notes the rice is Hiroshima-grown Koshihikari. Anago is grilled with a soy-and-mirin tare, and the rice underneath is cooked in eel stock seasoned with soy sauce - wheat both times. This is the only hot dish the shop sells.

items.en: Two oysters grilled in the shell
items.note: Grilled on the half shell with nothing but their own liquor, so the oyster itself is clean - the question is whether ponzu or soy sauce arrives with it. Ask for lemon. (A separate street sign for 山根商店, the oyster stall by the shop, prices its own plate of two lower; that is a different business, so use the in-shop card.)

items.en: Maboroshi daiginjo sake - Nakao Brewery, Takehara
items.note: The card's own note: polishing ratio 38%, sake meter value +3, fermented with a yeast isolated from apple skin, giving a rich aroma with a clean sweetness. The dearest pour on the card.

items.ja: 瑞冠（ずいかん）「こわっぱ」純米吟醸
items.en: Zuikan 'Kowappa' junmai ginjo sake - Yamaoka Brewery, Kounu
items.note: Card gives polishing 55%, sake meter +6. A dry Hiroshima junmai ginjo.

items.ja: 誠鏡（せいきょう）超辛口 本醸造
items.en: Seikyo extra-dry honjozo sake - Nakao Brewery, Takehara
items.note: Polishing 68%, sake meter +8 - the driest thing on the card. Honjozo has a small amount of distilled alcohol added; the base is still rice, but unlike junmai it is not a pure rice sake, so a strict celiac may want to ask what the added spirit is made from.

items.ja: 誠鏡（せいきょう）純米酒
items.en: Seikyo junmai sake - Nakao Brewery, Takehara
items.note: Polishing 65%, sake meter +1. Card describes a mellow aroma and the savour particular to a junmai; it has taken a bronze at the International Wine Challenge. Rice and koji only.

items.en: Draught Yebisu beer
items.note: Barley malt - never gluten-free.

items.en: Miyajima Beer, 330ml bottle - the island's own craft brew
items.note: Local craft beer brewed for Miyajima. Malt-based, so not gluten-free.

items.en: Cola
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-08 table card)
items.note: Bottled cola - no wheat, no animal products.

items.en: Apple juice
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-08 table card)
items.note: Bottled juice.

items.en: Orange juice
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-08 table card)
items.note: Bottled juice.

items.en: Oolong tea
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-08 table card)
items.note: Plain oolong - tea leaf and water, no barley. (Unlike mugicha, which is barley and is not gluten-free.)

hiro_kaeruttei.price_note: Transcribed from the shop's own laminated menu cards photographed 2022-04 - the only pictures of them online, and four years old, so treat every figure as a floor rather than the current price. The okonomimura.jp floor page for this stall did not respond at all when checked (connection times out), so there is no newer published list. Prices approximate - may change.

items.en: Okonomiyaki with pork and egg, no noodles
items.note: Card composition: pork and egg. Wheat batter and a wheat-and-soy okonomi sauce on a shared griddle. Cheapest way in.

items.ja: 肉・玉子・そば（うどん）
items.en: The standard: pork, egg and a layer of soba or udon noodles
items.note: Card lets you pick soba or udon - both wheat. This is the default Hiroshima order.

items.en: Special - pork, egg, squid-tempura crisp and noodles
items.note: Card composition: pork, egg, ika-ten, soba or udon. The ika-ten is a wheat-battered fried squid cracker.

items.en: 'Go on, try it' okonomiyaki - pork, egg, double squid crisp, spring onion and noodles
items.note: The name is Hiroshima dialect for 'give it a try'. Card composition: pork, egg, double ika-ten, negi, soba or udon.

items.en: Okonomiyaki with a hamburger patty inside - the shop's own recommendation
items.note: Card marks this its recommendation and suggests adding cheese for 170 yen. Composition: pork, egg, hamburg patty, soba or udon. Japanese hamburg patties are bound with panko, i.e. more wheat.

items.en: Deluxe - pork, egg, fresh squid, fresh prawn and noodles
items.note: Card composition as listed. Wheat batter, noodles, sauce.

items.en: Stamina deluxe - pork, egg, kimchi, garlic, squid crisp and noodles
items.note: Kimchi in Japan is normally made with fish sauce or dried shrimp as well as chilli, so this is not vegetarian either.

items.en: Oyster deluxe - pork, egg, Hiroshima oysters, spring onion and noodles
items.note: The Hiroshima combination worth ordering here: local oysters folded into the pancake.

items.ja: 具だくさんデラックス
items.en: Everything-in deluxe - pork, egg, fresh squid, fresh prawn, squid crisp, spring onion and noodles
items.note: Dearest pancake on the card.

items.en: Spring-onion okonomiyaki - pork, egg and a mountain of green onion
items.note: Wheat batter under the onion.

items.en: Spring-onion okonomiyaki finished with soy sauce instead of the sweet brown sauce
items.note: Soy sauce rather than okonomi sauce - lighter tasting, but soy sauce is wheat too.

items.en: Deluxe spring-onion okonomiyaki with fresh squid and prawn
items.note: Card composition: pork, egg, fresh squid, fresh prawn, negi.

items.en: Plain griddled noodles, soba or udon, on their own
items.note: Wheat noodles fried in the sauce - no pancake around them.

items.ja: デラックス焼そば（うどん）
items.en: Deluxe griddled noodles with pork, fresh squid and prawn
items.note: Card composition as listed.

items.en: Salt-seasoned griddled noodles with pork, bacon and shiso leaf
items.note: Salt rather than brown sauce, but the noodles themselves are wheat.

items.ja: トッピング：広島カキ・ホタテ
items.en: Add Hiroshima oysters or scallops
items.note: Shellfish itself is clean; the pancake and sauce it lands on are not.

items.ja: トッピング：生イカ・生エビ・スジこん・マヨッナ・キムチ・タコ
items.romaji: toppingu: nama-ika, nama-ebi, sujikon, mayotsuna, kimuchi, tako
items.en: Add fresh squid, fresh prawn, beef-tendon-and-konjac, tuna mayo, kimchi or octopus
items.note: Sujikon - beef tendon simmered with konjac - is a Hiroshima okonomiyaki classic and is simmered in soy sauce, so that one is a firm no. The others are wheat-free in themselves.

items.ja: トッピング：もち・イカ天・チーズ・コーン・ポテト・納豆・にんにく・ねぎ・玉ねぎ・しその葉
items.romaji: toppingu: mochi, ika-ten, chizu, kon, poteto, natto, ninniku, negi, tamanegi, shiso no ha
items.en: Add rice cake, squid crisp, cheese, corn, potato, natto, garlic, spring onion, onion or shiso leaf
items.note: Ika-ten is wheat-battered and natto comes with a soy-sauce sachet, so the group as a whole is not gluten-free; mochi, corn, potato, garlic and the alliums are individually fine but go onto a wheat pancake.

items.en: Griddled beef tongue with garlic soy sauce
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Garlic soy sauce - wheat. Dearest snack on the board.

items.en: Griddled beef short rib with garlic soy sauce
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Soy-based seasoning.

items.en: Griddled beef offal in chilli-bean sauce
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: 'Jan' means the doubanjiang-style chilli-miso sauce; Japanese chilli-bean pastes usually contain wheat.

items.ja: 広島かき鉄板焼（バター・ベーコン・蒸し）
items.en: Hiroshima oysters on the griddle - butter, bacon or steamed
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Three preparations under one price. The steamed version is the closest to gluten-free here - ask that it be done with sake and no soy sauce.

items.en: Pork in a thin omelette on the griddle
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Finished with okonomi sauce and mayonnaise.

items.en: Griddled pork and kimchi
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Kimchi is normally made with fish sauce; the pan is shared with wheat batter.

items.en: Ginger pork on the griddle
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Shogayaki sauce is soy sauce, mirin and ginger - wheat.

items.en: Simmered beef tendon
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Long-simmered in soy sauce and miso.

items.en: Pig's ear
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Usually served cold with ponzu or a vinegar dressing - ponzu is soy sauce, so ask.

items.en: Pig's trotter
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Griddled; dip usually ponzu.

items.en: Enoki mushrooms in butter and soy
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Soy sauce and butter.

items.en: Kimchi, as a side
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Japanese-made kimchi usually contains fish sauce, dried shrimp or bonito extract, and sometimes soy sauce. Ask before treating it as either.

items.en: Grilled sardine
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: If it is salt-grilled it is fine in itself; ask whether a soy dip comes with it.

items.en: Salted edamame
items.section: おつまみ Griddle snacks (2022-04 board)
items.note: Boiled green soy beans with salt only - nothing else is added, and they are not cooked on the wheat griddle. The one thing on this whole menu a celiac can eat, and the cheapest item on the board.

items.en: Draught beer
items.note: Barley malt.

items.en: Bottled beer
items.note: Barley malt.

items.en: Whisky highball
items.note: Whisky is a malt/grain spirit - treat as not gluten-free.

items.ja: 焼酎（麦・芋）水割り・お湯割り・ロック
items.en: Shochu, barley or sweet potato - with water, with hot water, or on the rocks
items.note: The board names both bases. Mugi-jochu is barley and is not gluten-free; ask for the imo (sweet potato) one if that matters.

items.en: Sake by the glass
items.note: Brand not given.

items.en: Chilled sake by the bottle
items.note: The board's printed 880 yen has been struck out and 1,100 handwritten over it - already repriced once by 2022.

items.ja: 微発泡清酒 TEDDAN（ボトル）
items.en: TEDDAN lightly sparkling sake, bottle
items.note: A gently fizzy sake - a good match for a griddle meal.

items.en: Shochu highballs - lemon, calpis, lime, grapefruit, kyoho grape, oolong and others; on the rocks available
items.note: Base shochu unstated and the board offers a barley one elsewhere, so ask which base goes into these.

items.ja: サングリア（赤・白ワインベース）
items.en: Sangria, red or white wine base
items.note: Wine-based; some wines are fined with animal products.

items.en: Wine by the bottle, red or white
items.note: From price; grape variety unstated.

items.ja: ノンアルコールビール
items.en: Alcohol-free beer
items.note: Still brewed from barley malt - alcohol-free is not gluten-free.

items.ja: ソフトドリンク 各種
items.en: Soft drinks - cola, orange, calpis, oolong tea, ramune, ginger ale
items.note: All six named on the board are wheat-free; calpis is a milk drink, so not vegan. Cheapest drinks in the building.
